NoSQLServer v0.64 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Non-recursive multi-CTE dependency resolution.

Architecture
------------
- WITH cte1 AS (...), cte2 AS (...), ... is parsed in declaration order.
- Each CTE body is executed by an ordinary NoSQLServerSQL facade.
- Successful CTE results are materialized into statement-local SQLMaterializedTable
  instances.
- SQLCTEEngineOverlay resolves CTE names before delegating to the underlying engine.
- Later CTEs can therefore query/join earlier CTEs using the normal SQL machinery.
- The outer query sees all prior CTEs through the same overlay.
- CTE names do not leak into the underlying persistent/object catalog after the
  statement completes.
- Forward references are not invented; a CTE may only reference prior declarations.
- Duplicate CTE names are rejected.
- CTE column-name lists remain outside this release.
- Recursive WITH remains on the existing dedicated WITH RECURSIVE path.

Only Alan exceeds his department mean, so the independently verified result is:
  Alan Engineer | dept 10 | 15.5 | 7.833333...
